Deals 200% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 60% chance to reduce the target's ATK by 20% for 2 turns.

Increases all allies' SPD by 20% for 2 turns and Turn Meter by 12%.

Conch DefensePassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the beginning of Olivia's turn, she will grant the ally with the lowest HP percentage [Ally Protection] and restore the ally's HP by 8% of Olivia's Max HP. Olivia will take 50% of the DMG dealt to the ally instead until the beginning of her next turn.
Conch Lance&Shield Lv.2Reduces DMG dealt to the ally with [Ally Protection] granted by Conch Defense by 10%.

Increases all allies' DEF by 30% for 2 turns and grants all allies a [Shield] equal to 20% of Olivia's Max HP for 2 turns.
